en.headline: Ex-Wang Fuk Court committee member charged over loan scheme
en.dek: Kong Cheung-fat, 64, and his wife Cheung Yeuk-lan, 62, face two fraud counts and one money-laundering count over the 100 per cent guarantee loan scheme, police said.
body: A former member of the Wang Fuk Court owners corporation management committee and his wife have been charged over alleged fraud involving the government's 100 per cent Guarantee Product, police said on Sunday.

Kong Cheung-fat, 64, and Cheung Yeuk-lan, 62, face two counts of fraud and one count of dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence, commonly called money laundering. The case is listed for mention at Sha Tin Magistrates Courts on Tuesday, 1 September.

New Territories South Regional Crime Unit officers arrested the couple in Yuen Long on 14 May after a report that a design-and-engineering company had obtained loans under the pandemic relief scheme. They were released on bail two days later. Media reports said the pair were directors of Yisi Interior Design Engineering Limited and that the alleged loans ran to several hundred thousand dollars.

The couple have not entered a plea. They are entitled to the presumption of innocence. The charges are separate from the government's buyout of Wang Fuk Court flats, whose acceptance deadline is 5pm on Monday.

zh.headline: 宏福苑前法團委員江祥發夫婦被控詐騙及洗黑錢
zh.dek: 64歲江祥發及62歲妻子張若蘭被控兩項詐騙及一項洗黑錢罪，案件周二在沙田裁判法院提堂，涉百分百擔保特惠貸款。
body: 警方周日表示，大埔宏福苑業主立案法團前管理委員會委員江祥發及其妻子，已就涉嫌詐騙政府「百分百擔保特惠貸款計劃」被落案起訴。
64歲江祥發及62歲張若蘭被控兩項詐騙罪，以及一項處理已知道或相信為代表從可公訴罪行的得益的財產罪（俗稱洗黑錢）。案件定於9月1日（周二）在沙田裁判法院提堂。
新界南總區重案組今年5月14日在元朗拘捕兩人，指接獲報案懷疑一間室內設計工程公司藉該抗疫貸款計劃取得貸款，兩人其後於16日獲准保釋。傳媒報道指兩人為藝鍶室內設計工程有限公司董事，涉款數十萬元。
兩人尚未答辯，在法庭定罪前須推定無罪。控罪與宏福苑政府收購業權安排無關；收購接受書限期為周一傍晚5時。
